svg.title: Freestyle white style symbol
svg.desc: Native silhouette traced from the user's Freestyle Mastery reference, 1621.jpg. The white character, angular side caps, two open counters and diagonal upper stroke are retained. Revision 2 uses lighter 20–22-unit main strokes, rendered at 0.45 scale for a 110.25-unit visible height. Use this same symbol for every Freestyle category.
